import os
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com"  # produção: https://api.asaas.com
HEADERS = {
    "access_token": os.environ["ASAAS_API_KEY"],  # <<SUA_API_KEY>> — nunca deixe fixa no código
    "User-Agent": "minha-integracao/1.0",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def asaas(method, path, *, params=None, body=None, tentativas=3):
    """Chama a API; repete apenas em 429 (requisição recusada, sem efeito) e, em leituras, em 5xx."""
    for i in range(tentativas):
        r = requests.request(method, BASE_URL + path, headers=HEADERS, params=params, json=body, timeout=30)
        ultima = i == tentativas - 1
        if r.status_code == 429 and not ultima:
            time.sleep(int(r.headers.get("RateLimit-Reset", "5")) + 1)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 500 and method == "GET" and not ultima:
            time.sleep(2 ** i)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                detalhe = r.json().get("errors", r.text)
            except ValueError:
                detalhe = r.text
            raise RuntimeError(f"Asaas HTTP {r.status_code}: {detalhe}")
        return r.json() if r.content else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    payload = {
    "name": "Cliente Exemplo Ltda",
    "cpfCnpj": "00000000000191",
    "email": "financeiro@example.com",
    "mobilePhone": "11900000000",
    "postalCode": "01001000",
    "addressNumber": "100",
    "externalReference": "CLI-001",
    "notificationDisabled": False
}
    # Sem idempotência na API: em timeout, consulte antes de reenviar (ex.: pelo externalReference).
    resultado = asaas("POST", "/v3/customers", body=payload)
    print(resultado)

let
    // Recomendado: crie o parâmetro "AsaasApiKey" (Gerenciar Parâmetros) e use-o aqui em vez de texto fixo.
    ApiKey = "<<SUA_API_KEY>>",
    BaseUrl = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com", // produção: https://api.asaas.com
    PageSize = 100,
    GetPage = (offset as number) as record =>
        let
            Resp = Web.Contents(BaseUrl, [
                RelativePath = "v3/customers",
                Query = [limit = Text.From(PageSize), offset = Text.From(offset)],
                Headers = [access_token = ApiKey, #"User-Agent" = "powerbi-asaas/1.0", #"Content-Type" = "application/json"],
                ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500}
            ]),
            Status = Value.Metadata(Resp)[Response.Status],
            Result = if Status >= 400
                then error Error.Record("Asaas HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resp))
                else Json.Document(Resp)
        in
            Result,
    // Percorre offset até hasMore = false
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [offset = 0, page = GetPage(0)],
        each [page] <> null,
        each if Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "hasMore", false) = true
             then [offset = [offset] + PageSize, page = GetPage([offset] + PageSize)]
             else [offset = [offset], page = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "data", {})
    ),
    Registros = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Base = Table.FromList(Registros, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"r"}),
    Expandida = Table.ExpandRecordColumn(Base, "r", {"id", "dateCreated", "name", "cpfCnpj", "email", "externalReference", "object", "phone", "mobilePhone", "address", "addressNumber", "complement"}),
    Tipada = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Expandida, {{"id", type text}, {"dateCreated", type text}, {"name", type text}, {"cpfCnpj", type text}, {"email", type text}, {"externalReference", type text}, {"object", type text}, {"phone", type text}, {"mobilePhone", type text}, {"address", type text}, {"addressNumber", type text}, {"complement", type text}})
in
    Tipada

snippets.power_query_m:
let
    // Recomendado: crie o parâmetro "AsaasApiKey" (Gerenciar Parâmetros) e use-o aqui em vez de texto fixo.
    ApiKey = "<<SUA_API_KEY>>",
    BaseUrl = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com", // produção: https://api.asaas.com
    PageSize = 100,
    GetPage = (offset as number) as record =>
        let
            Resp = Web.Contents(BaseUrl, [
                RelativePath = "v3/payments",
                Query = [limit = Text.From(PageSize), offset = Text.From(offset)],
                Headers = [access_token = ApiKey, #"User-Agent" = "powerbi-asaas/1.0", #"Content-Type" = "application/json"],
                ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500}
            ]),
            Status = Value.Metadata(Resp)[Response.Status],
            Result = if Status >= 400
                then error Error.Record("Asaas HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resp))
                else Json.Document(Resp)
        in
            Result,
    // Percorre offset até hasMore = false
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [offset = 0, page = GetPage(0)],
        each [page] <> null,
        each if Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "hasMore", false) = true
             then [offset = [offset] + PageSize, page = GetPage([offset] + PageSize)]
             else [offset = [offset], page = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "data", {})
    ),
    Registros = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Base = Table.FromList(Registros, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"r"}),
    Expandida = Table.ExpandRecordColumn(Base, "r", {"id", "dateCreated", "customer", "value", "netValue", "billingType", "status", "dueDate", "paymentDate", "externalReference", "description", "invoiceUrl"}),
    Tipada = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Expandida, {{"id", type text}, {"dateCreated", type date}, {"customer", type text}, {"value", type number}, {"netValue", type number}, {"billingType", type text}, {"status", type text}, {"dueDate", type date}, {"paymentDate", type date}, {"externalReference", type text}, {"description", type text}, {"invoiceUrl", type text}})
in
    Tipada

    ApiKey = "<<SUA_API_KEY>>",
    BaseUrl = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com", // produção: https://api.asaas.com
    RecursoId = "pay_000000000001", // id do recurso (troque ou transforme em parâmetro)
    PageSize = 100,
    GetPage = (offset as number) as record =>
        let
            Resp = Web.Contents(BaseUrl, [
                RelativePath = "v3/payments/" & RecursoId & "/refunds",
                Query = [limit = Text.From(PageSize), offset = Text.From(offset)],
                Headers = [access_token = ApiKey, #"User-Agent" = "powerbi-asaas/1.0", #"Content-Type" = "application/json"],
                ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500}

    // Percorre offset até hasMore = false

import os
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com"  # produção: https://api.asaas.com
HEADERS = {
    "access_token": os.environ["ASAAS_API_KEY"],  # <<SUA_API_KEY>> — nunca deixe fixa no código
    "User-Agent": "minha-integracao/1.0",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def asaas(method, path, *, params=None, body=None, tentativas=3):
    """Chama a API; repete apenas em 429 (requisição recusada, sem efeito) e, em leituras, em 5xx."""
    for i in range(tentativas):
        r = requests.request(method, BASE_URL + path, headers=HEADERS, params=params, json=body, timeout=30)
        ultima = i == tentativas - 1
        if r.status_code == 429 and not ultima:
            time.sleep(int(r.headers.get("RateLimit-Reset", "5")) + 1)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 500 and method == "GET" and not ultima:
            time.sleep(2 ** i)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                detalhe = r.json().get("errors", r.text)
            except ValueError:
                detalhe = r.text
            raise RuntimeError(f"Asaas HTTP {r.status_code}: {detalhe}")
        return r.json() if r.content else None

import os
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com"  # produção: https://api.asaas.com
HEADERS = {
    "access_token": os.environ["ASAAS_API_KEY"],  # <<SUA_API_KEY>> — nunca deixe fixa no código
    "User-Agent": "minha-integracao/1.0",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def asaas(method, path, *, params=None, body=None, tentativas=3):
    """Chama a API; repete apenas em 429 (requisição recusada, sem efeito) e, em leituras, em 5xx."""
    for i in range(tentativas):
        r = requests.request(method, BASE_URL + path, headers=HEADERS, params=params, json=body, timeout=30)
        ultima = i == tentativas - 1
        if r.status_code == 429 and not ultima:
            time.sleep(int(r.headers.get("RateLimit-Reset", "5")) + 1)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 500 and method == "GET" and not ultima:
            time.sleep(2 ** i)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                detalhe = r.json().get("errors", r.text)
            except ValueError:
                detalhe = r.text
            raise RuntimeError(f"Asaas HTTP {r.status_code}: {detalhe}")
        return r.json() if r.content else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    payload = {

let
    // Recomendado: crie o parâmetro "AsaasApiKey" (Gerenciar Parâmetros) e use-o aqui em vez de texto fixo.
    ApiKey = "<<SUA_API_KEY>>",
    BaseUrl = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com", // produção: https://api.asaas.com
    PageSize = 100,
    GetPage = (offset as number) as record =>
        let
            Resp = Web.Contents(BaseUrl, [
                RelativePath = "v3/accounts",
                Query = [limit = Text.From(PageSize), offset = Text.From(offset)],
                Headers = [access_token = ApiKey, #"User-Agent" = "powerbi-asaas/1.0", #"Content-Type" = "application/json"],
                ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500}
            ]),
            Status = Value.Metadata(Resp)[Response.Status],
            Result = if Status >= 400
                then error Error.Record("Asaas HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resp))
                else Json.Document(Resp)
        in
            Result,
    // Percorre offset até hasMore = false
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [offset = 0, page = GetPage(0)],
        each [page] <> null,
        each if Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "hasMore", false) = true
             then [offset = [offset] + PageSize, page = GetPage([offset] + PageSize)]
             else [offset = [offset], page = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "data", {})
    ),
    Registros = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Base = Table.FromList(Registros, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"r"}),
    Expandida = Table.ExpandRecordColumn(Base, "r", {"id", "name", "cpfCnpj", "email", "walletId", "object", "loginEmail", "phone", "mobilePhone", "address", "addressNumber", "complement"}),
    Tipada = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Expandida, {{"id", type text}, {"name", type text}, {"cpfCnpj", type text}, {"email", type text}, {"walletId", type text}, {"object", type text}, {"loginEmail", type text}, {"phone", type text}, {"mobilePhone", type text}, {"address", type text}, {"addressNumber", type text}, {"complement", type text}})

    Tipada

import os
import time
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com"  # produção: https://api.asaas.com
HEADERS = {
    "access_token": os.environ["ASAAS_API_KEY"],  # <<SUA_API_KEY>> — nunca deixe fixa no código
    "User-Agent": "minha-integracao/1.0",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def asaas(method, path, *, params=None, body=None, tentativas=3):
    """Chama a API; repete apenas em 429 (requisição recusada, sem efeito) e, em leituras, em 5xx."""
    for i in range(tentativas):
        r = requests.request(method, BASE_URL + path, headers=HEADERS, params=params, json=body, timeout=30)
        ultima = i == tentativas - 1
        if r.status_code == 429 and not ultima:
            time.sleep(int(r.headers.get("RateLimit-Reset", "5")) + 1)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 500 and method == "GET" and not ultima:
            time.sleep(2 ** i)
            continue
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                detalhe = r.json().get("errors", r.text)
            except ValueError:
                detalhe = r.text
            raise RuntimeError(f"Asaas HTTP {r.status_code}: {detalhe}")
        return r.json() if r.content else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    payload = {
    "name": "ERP - cobranças",
    "url": "https://erp.example.com/webhooks/asaas",
    "email": "ti@example.com",
    "enabled": True,
    "interrupted": False,
    "apiVersion": 3,
    "authToken": "<<TOKEN_ALEATORIO_32_A_255_CARACTERES>>",
    "sendType": "SEQUENTIALLY",
    "events": [
        "PAYMENT_RECEIVED",
        "PAYMENT_OVERDUE"
    ]
}
    # Sem idempotência na API: em timeout, consulte antes de reenviar (ex.: pelo externalReference).
    resultado = asaas("POST", "/v3/webhooks", body=payload)
    print(resultado)

snippets.power_query_m:
let
    // Recomendado: crie o parâmetro "AsaasApiKey" (Gerenciar Parâmetros) e use-o aqui em vez de texto fixo.
    ApiKey = "<<SUA_API_KEY>>",
    BaseUrl = "https://api-sandbox.asaas.com", // produção: https://api.asaas.com
    PageSize = 100,
    GetPage = (offset as number) as record =>
        let
            Resp = Web.Contents(BaseUrl, [
                RelativePath = "v3/webhooks",
                Query = [limit = Text.From(PageSize), offset = Text.From(offset)],
                Headers = [access_token = ApiKey, #"User-Agent" = "powerbi-asaas/1.0", #"Content-Type" = "application/json"],
                ManualStatusHandling = {400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500}
            ]),
            Status = Value.Metadata(Resp)[Response.Status],
            Result = if Status >= 400
                then error Error.Record("Asaas HTTP " & Text.From(Status), Text.FromBinary(Resp))
                else Json.Document(Resp)
        in
            Result,
    // Percorre offset até hasMore = false
    Paginas = List.Generate(
        () => [offset = 0, page = GetPage(0)],
        each [page] <> null,
        each if Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "hasMore", false) = true
             then [offset = [offset] + PageSize, page = GetPage([offset] + PageSize)]
             else [offset = [offset], page = null],
        each Record.FieldOrDefault([page], "data", {})
    ),
    Registros = List.Combine(Paginas),
    Base = Table.FromList(Registros, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"r"}),
    Expandida = Table.ExpandRecordColumn(Base, "r", {"id", "name", "email", "url", "enabled", "interrupted", "apiVersion", "hasAuthToken", "sendType", "penalizedRequestsCount"}),
    Tipada = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Expandida, {{"id", type text}, {"name", type text}, {"email", type text}, {"url", type text}, {"enabled", type logical}, {"interrupted", type logical}, {"apiVersion", Int64.Type}, {"hasAuthToken", type logical}, {"sendType", type text}, {"penalizedRequestsCount", Int64.Type}})
in
    Tipada
